title: Share m of traders follow one model's trend (toy, ours)
note: Price gap from fair value (0 = fair). A shock of −1 hits after step 3. A share m of traders chase the last move; the rest pull the price back.
readout: Largest swing {max_P:.2f} up, {min_P:.2f} down; gap after {t:d} steps: {P:.3f}.
caption: Rule (ours): gap(t+1) = gap(t) + 1.5·m·[gap(t) − gap(t−1)] − 0.5·(1−m)·gap(t). Trend-followers add the last move; the others pull the gap back to 0. The breaker caps the gap. Toy, ours: it does not measure how many firms really share a model.
